chapters.label: Live
chapters.text: Dortmund, 1974. The Netherlands, in orange, play Sweden. On the left, Johan Cruyff has the ball. Defender Jan Olsson is right behind him. Cruyff gets ready to pass... then, suddenly, he's gone!

chapters.label: The replay
chapters.text: Watch it slowly. Cruyff fakes the pass. Then he uses the inside of his foot to drag the ball behind his standing leg, spins round, and speeds away. Olsson goes the wrong way!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: The game ended nil-nil, but everyone remembers the Cruyff turn. Fake the pass, drag the ball behind your standing leg, and turn away fast.
